class.name: JarDisplaceSdf
class.brief_description: Displaces its child field's surface with 3D noise.
class.description: Useful for rocky boulders and natural-looking caves. Displacement can bend the field enough that it is no longer an exact distance, which is fine for meshing and edits.

members.member: Noise sampled at each point; values in [code][-1, 1][/code].
